title: AgentResponse
description: Python AI agent → Go supervisor. Go acts on this immediately for dispatch and dashboard updates. One response per zone batch.

event_id.description: Must match the event_id from the corresponding AgentRequest

zone.description: Zone batch this response covers — must match the request zone

decisions.description: One DeviceDecision per device in the request batch, in any order

gov_narrative.description: Situation report for the government dashboard. Plain text, factual, no PII. Shown to officials.
gov_narrative.example: Red zone: 12 devices detected within 5km of epicenter. Network congestion HIGH. 9 reachable via SMS, 3 unreachable flagged for rescue. QoS boost requested.

request_qos.description: If true, Go will call CAMARA QoS on Demand API to boost network priority for this zone

confidence.description: AI confidence in this batch's overall decision set

phone.description: E.164 phone — must match a phone in the request devices list

zone_confirmed.description: AI-confirmed zone. May differ from Go's zone only if zone_escalated=true

zone_escalated.description: true if AI upgraded the zone (e.g. orange→red). Go logs this for audit.

action.description: 'sms' = send SMS only | 'rescue_flag' = flag for rescue only | 'both' = SMS + rescue | 'none' = no action

sms_message.description: Exact SMS text to send. Empty string if action is 'rescue_flag' or 'none'. Max 160 chars for single SMS.
sms_message.example: ALERTE: Séisme détecté. Évacuez immédiatement vers École Ibn Battouta (1.2km nord). Évitez les bâtiments endommagés.

rescue_priority.description: 1=highest rescue urgency, 0=not flagged for rescue. Higher = dispatched first.

reasoning.description: Internal audit log — AI's reasoning chain. NEVER shown to end users or sent via SMS.
reasoning.example: Device unreachable via data/SMS, located in red zone collapse risk area, high aftershock risk — escalating to rescue_flag priority 1.

decisions.sms_message: ALERTE: Séisme détecté. Évacuez vers École Ibn Battouta (1.2km nord). Évitez les bâtiments endommagés.
decisions.reasoning: Device reachable via SMS, located in red zone. Standard evacuation SMS sent. Shelter 1.2km away, capacity available.
Device NOT_CONNECTED. Location within 2km of epicenter. High collapse risk zone. Cannot reach via any channel — rescue dispatch required.

examples.gov_narrative: Red zone: 2 devices processed. 1 reachable via SMS — evacuation message sent. 1 unreachable (NOT_CONNECTED) in high-collapse-risk area — rescue team dispatched. QoS boost requested to improve SMS delivery in congested area.
